description: An uncommon inflammatory skin condition that usually presents with tiny skin-coloured papules, often beginning in childhood.
symptoms: Tiny papules may be asymptomatic or itchy.
risk_factors: It can occur in children and young adults.
It has been reported in association with lichen planus, Crohn disease, Down syndrome, atopic dermatitis and other conditions.

appearance.general: Pinpoint to pinhead-sized, flat-topped, shiny papules that may be skin-coloured, yellow, red-brown or violet.
appearance.dark_skin: DermNet reports that papules can be hypo- or hyperpigmented in dark skin.
